findings.title: Test name is garbled and repeats itself
findings.why: The title 'cancel invalid cancellations throw; invalid cancellations throw' repeats a phrase. The original read 'cancel after the start refunds nothing; invalid cancellations throw', and the rename dropped the part that describes the last assertion (cancelling at the start refunds 0).

findings.title: Plan document is still the unfilled scaffold
findings.why: The plan body is only the placeholder comment. The comment tells the author to replace it, and the file has no plan content. The `element` and `parent` fields are empty and `status` is active. task-006 also still carries the scaffold comment above its body.
